BiblicalUsage: Cassia goes into the holy anointing oil — five hundred shekels of it — and it turns up again in Tyre's market among the bright iron and calamus. The same bark perfumes the priest and the merchant.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the spices of the anointing oil were measured by God's own hand, and even cassia has a place in his worship.
